Question:
I'd like to work from another Canadian city for 12 business days using my personal laptop. Who may approve the location change, and what personal-device access and download limits still apply?

Retrieved context (grouped by document):
=== Document: HR-002 — PTO and Leave Policy ===

[Section: Vacation Entitlement]
Chunk ID: 79e28ac2-ea1b-45ff-9a0d-d5ca18b2b19e
Score: 0.7292
Content:
Vacation Entitlement

Full-time employees receive 20 paid vacation days per calendar year. Vacation is accrued monthly and may be used after the employee's first 30 days of employment. Part-time employees receive prorated vacation based on scheduled weekly hours.

Employees may carry over up to 5 unused vacation days into the next calendar year. Carried-over days must be used by March 31 or they expire unless local law requires a different outcome.

[Section: Vacation Approval Workflow]
Chunk ID: 483a6ce6-f231-4b14-9190-948b5d6cd35b
Score: 0.6059
Content:
Vacation Approval Workflow

Vacation requests of 1 to 5 business days should be submitted at least 10 business days in advance. Requests longer than 5 business days should be submitted at least 20 business days in advance.

Managers approve vacation based on business coverage, project deadlines, and fairness across the team. Managers should not deny vacation without explaining the business reason.

[Section: Parental Leave Summary]
Chunk ID: a3d2beee-aea8-4d4f-bbf7-07017884bf45
Score: 0.5585
Content:
Parental Leave Summary

Eligible full-time employees may receive up to 12 weeks of company-supported parental leave after 6 months of service. Local statutory benefits may apply separately. Employees should contact People Operations at least 60 days before the expected leave date when possible.

This document provides a company policy summary and does not provide legal advice.

[Section: Missing Policy Areas]
Chunk ID: 50227ee4-84db-49ca-b46e-df7b730ecc0e
Score: 0.5491
Content:
Missing Policy Areas

Northstar does not publish a sabbatical policy in the employee knowledge base. Employees asking about sabbaticals should contact People Operations.

[Section: Sick Leave]
Chunk ID: 4d0ae131-80d4-4c78-b6cf-7523be37c236
Score: 0.5317
Content:
Sick Leave

Employees receive 8 paid sick days per calendar year. Sick time may be used for personal illness, medical appointments, or short-term caregiving needs. Employees should notify their manager as soon as practical when taking sick leave.

Medical details should not be shared in team channels. People Operations may request documentation only when required by policy or law.

=== Document: IT-002 — Device and BYOD Security Policy ===

[Section: Personal Devices]
Chunk ID: 66a0bffd-898c-4c16-abf0-817b06af59d3
Score: 0.7866
Content:
Personal Devices

Personal devices may be used for limited work access only when enrolled in approved mobile device management or when access occurs through approved browser-based tools. Personal devices must use a passcode, supported operating system, and automatic lock.

Restricted data must not be downloaded to personal devices. Confidential data should be accessed only through approved company systems.

[Section: Company Devices]
Chunk ID: e63e8dbf-a320-4863-83cf-939dd76f89ca
Score: 0.7457
Content:
Company Devices

Employees who regularly access company systems should use a company-managed device. Company devices must have disk encryption, endpoint protection, automatic screen lock, and current operating system updates.

Employees may not disable security tools or remove device management controls from company devices.

[Section: Lost or Stolen Devices]
Chunk ID: b452b9a3-8eb8-4961-a175-0fbf78809fb2
Score: 0.4968
Content:
Lost or Stolen Devices

Employees must report lost or stolen devices to IT Support within 2 hours of discovery. The report should include the device type, last known location, whether customer data may have been accessed, and whether the device was company-managed or personal.

=== Document: HR-003 — Remote and Hybrid Work Policy ===

[Section: Security Expectations]
Chunk ID: 47fe8690-3f57-4a00-99a4-17175db78840
Score: 0.6782
Content:
Security Expectations

Remote work must follow the Device and BYOD Security Policy and the Data Classification and Handling Policy. Confidential and restricted data may only be accessed on approved devices using company-approved tools.

=== Document: IT-001 — Acceptable Use Policy ===

[Section: Related Policies]
Chunk ID: 7a7d5ae9-d0ec-448e-972f-f4303132fd00
Score: 0.6617
Content:
Related Policies

Device requirements are defined in the Device and BYOD Security Policy. Data handling requirements are defined in the Data Classification and Handling Policy.
